name: Senior backend engineer, clear requirements
job_text:
Senior Backend Engineer
Verdant Logistics — Lisbon (hybrid, 2 days on site)

We move two million parcels a day and our routing platform decides how. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own it.

What you will do:
- Design and build the services that plan delivery routes at scale
- Own the PostgreSQL schema behind carrier reconciliation
- Mentor two junior engineers on the team
- Take our remaining Flask endpoints across to FastAPI

What we are looking for:
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience
- Strong Python
- Solid PostgreSQL, including query tuning
- Experience designing distributed systems and owning their architecture
- Right to work in Portugal

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes
- Familiarity with Go
- Experience in logistics or supply chain

We offer a competitive salary and 25 days of leave.
